_comment: Golden Chef Journey story text. Edit freely; src/core/story.ts validates it (tests fail if a page, visit or recipe is missing). {name} = the chef's name, {dish} = the dish being ordered. Never use he/she for the chef.

body: Our apple stall is yours now! I'm off to see the world.
Instead of a cookbook, I left you my notebook of riddles. Each new page brings a new dish.
Be kind to every customer and pick your apples well. See you soon!

pages.title: Aomori Bay
pages.riddle: Squeeze me and I'm a drink. Cut me just right and I grow two long ears. What am I?

doodle.caption: Me, trying rabbit ears. They look like cats!

pages.where: Our stall is by Aomori Bay. Wave to ASPAM, the big triangle building!

pages.title: Sweet and sticky
pages.riddle: Bubble me slowly in a pot and I spread on toast. Dip me in shiny red sugar and I'm a festival treat.

doodle.caption: A jar of jam. (I ate it all.)

postcard.text: Greetings from Norway! The fjords are SO tall. I told a ship captain called Ingrid all about your apples.

pages.title: Off to Lake Towada
pages.riddle: Hirosaki's favourite: apples tucked in golden pastry. And my breakfast: jam on crunchy bread.

postcard.text: Bonjour from Paris! Chef Amélie bakes an upside-down apple tart. I said my grandchild's pie is better!

pages.where: Time to move! Set up the stall beside Lake Towada, where the water is deep and blue.

pages.title: The red gates
pages.riddle: Layer me with cold yogurt. Bake me whole until I'm soft. Simmer me slowly until I shine.

doodle.caption: A flying fox stole my apple!

postcard.text: G'day from Queensland! Carer Mia looks after baby flying foxes. They love juicy fruit, just like you.

pages.where: Pack up! Next stop: Takayama Inari Shrine and its hill of red torii gates.

pages.title: The last page
pages.where: You found every dish, {name}. A Golden Chef! I've told the whole world about our stall, so keep an eye on the post...

regulars.name: Sota
regulars.tagline: Wants to be a chef one day

visits.line: Hi! I'm Sota. I'm going to be a chef too! Can I watch you make {dish}?
I practised your moves at home! Swish, swish! Could I have {dish}, please, Chef {name}?
What's your best tip, Chef {name}? Mine is: always wash the apples! {dish}, please.
I opened a pretend apple stall next door! But today I'm the customer. {dish}, please!

regulars.name: Yui
regulars.tagline: Learning to cook for her little brother

visits.line: Hello! I'm Yui. I'm learning to cook for my little brother. Is {dish} hard to make?
My brother loved the last one! Could I have {dish}? I'll watch how you do it.
I tried something harder at home. It was... a little burnt. Could I have {dish}, please?
I made jam all by myself! It's lumpy, but it's for you. And {dish}, please!

regulars.name: Grandpa Kiyoshi
regulars.tagline: Loves pie apples... for some reason

visits.line: Good day! I'm Kiyoshi. {dish}, please. Oh, and do you sell pie apples? No reason!
{dish}, please. And six more pie apples... still no reason!
All right, I'll tell you. I'm entering the town pie contest! Wish me luck. {dish}, please.
Second place in the pie contest! This ribbon is half yours, Chef {name}. Let's celebrate with {dish}!
Hi, I'm Mei! I collect apples too. Aomori grows more apples than anywhere else in Japan! {dish}, please.
Apple fact: the Fuji apple was first grown here in Aomori! {dish}, please.
Apple fact: apples float because about a quarter of an apple is air! {dish}, please.
This is my rarest apple, Oirase, named after a stream near Lake Towada. It's yours! And {dish}, please.

news.title: Thank you!
news.text: Thanks for letting me watch you cook!
news.headline: Sota pinned a note to your stall

news.title: Aomori Daily
news.text: Chef {name}'s apple stall is the talk of the town!
news.headline: Your stall is in the newspaper!

news.title: You're invited!
news.text: Come and cook at the Hirosaki Apple Festival!
news.headline: A letter came in the post

news.title: The Golden Apple award
news.text: The whole town cheers for Chef {name}! And look who's here...
news.headline: A ceremony, just for you

ojiichanVisit.line: Surprise! I came home for your big day, {name}. One {dish} for your proud Ojiichan, please!
ojiichanVisit.tagline: Your grandpa, home from his travels!

prologue.bye: Ojiichan is off to see the world!
prologue.arrive: Next morning, {name} arrives at the apple stall by Aomori Bay...
prologue.note: There's a note on the counter!

firstLetter: When your stall does well, people send you notes, newspapers and invitations. Keep them all in your Scrapbook (in My chef).
